description: Change one of the linked account's saved styles in plain words, for example 'bigger yellow captions, no zooms' or 'open on the strongest line'. Saves it as the style's next version; every later video in that style follows it, and earlier versions are kept. Preserve operation_id on retries.

operation_id.description: A stable ID for this authorized request. Preserve it on retries. Use a new ID only for a deliberate new request.

name: adjust_style

outputSchema.description: Clypmint adjust_style result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Change a style
